# Castlevania II: Simon's Quest Archipelago Version 1.0 #
* Initial Release
## Base Game Changes ##
  - The game now has a save system instead of a password.
  - Lives are removed, you can no longer game over
  - To save the game, hold A + B and press Start
  - The message text speed has been increased
  - Oak Stake is now a permanent item and cannot be used up
  - You no longer have to buy Garlic/Laurels. Instead, once you have the respective item, you can refill them for free at any church.
  - You can unequip your current item by pressing Select on the menu
  - You can swap between Crystals by hovering over it in the inventory and pressing A
  - Crystals now ONLY perform their designated function.
  - The day/night transition has a faster speed
  - Your current hearts and item selections are saved into your file
  - The heart cap has been raised from 256 to 9999
  - Bosses no longer respawn

## Known Issues ##
- N/A

## Disclaimer ##
- No AI was used in the making of this project
